g.text: Avatar Crop Lifecycle — Root Cause Analysis
on the INSIDE a small circular overflow:hidden container.
The overlay image is ~90vw wide. The circular avatar is 24-80px.
translate(X,Y) values from the large overlay are HUGE relative
Example: overlay image 300px wide, user pans 50px right.
tx=50. In a 24px badge, translate(50px,0) pushes the
image completely out of the circle → shows background → R fallback.
FIX: Scale tx/ty relative to container size, not absolute pixels.
rb-member-badge creates <rb-avatar> with src and name
but does NOT pass crop attribute.
ProfileEditor does not pass crop either.
crop data exists in profile but is never propagated
to the initial rb-avatar attribute at creation time.
FIX: Pass crop from profile/member data to rb-avatar.
